🛢️ Midland Basin DCA — Automated Decline Curve Analysis

Martin County, TX · 30 horizontal oil wells · Hyperbolic Arps with 8%/yr terminal decline · $65/bbl oil, $2.00/mcf gas · Economic limit 108–137 bbl/mo where cash flow turns negative · 50-yr max well life
📊 Production: public Texas Railroad Commission (RRC) monthly production records, Martin County, TX — 30 horizontal oil wells, single-well leases, Jan 2022–Mar 2026 (last reported month). Obtained via the open dataset Dansaad2020/ai-ml-dca-permian, which republishes RRC production, permit, wellbore and completion records; RRC's interactive query endpoints were unreachable at build time, so the data was not pulled directly from rrc.texas.gov. Trailing months with no reported volume for any well are treated as not yet reported. See README for full provenance.
P50 is the fitted forecast. P90 and P10 are the 10th and 90th percentiles of a 1,000-member ensemble (block bootstrap of the fit plus a level factor), calibrated so 80% of held-out 6–18 month volumes fell inside the range in a leave-one-well-out hindcast. Beyond 18 months the range is the model's extrapolation. For wells with b held at the 1.2 cap the range is skewed low: members can only have lower b, so b adds no upside.

Well economics & fit

PDP economics, flat prices: $65/bbl oil, $2.00/mcf casinghead gas at each well's last-12-month GOR; 75.0% NRI, 100% WI; Texas severance 4.6% oil / 7.5% gas, ad valorem 2.5%; LOE $6,000/well-month + $4.00/bbl; PV at 10%/yr, mid-month, from the month after the last report. No capex, workovers or abandonment cost.

Observed type curve

Monthly oil by month on production across the cohort (P25–P75 band, P50 line). It stops where fewer than 80% of the wells are still reporting; later months would describe a small, older subset. Download CSV

Decline-shape clusters

Wells grouped by decline shape: how much of its peak rate each well's fitted decline keeps after one and three producing years — the basis for type curves and benchmarking. The number of groups is chosen by silhouette score. Hollow markers are low-confidence fits; they are assigned to the nearest group but do not shape it.

Built as a freelance portfolio project · Methodology: Arps hyperbolic decline fit from peak rate on producing time (shut-in months and months well under trend count only part of a month and are down-weighted in the fit), b ≤ 1.2, robust soft-L1 loss; 8%/yr terminal decline, forecast to the economic limit 108–137 bbl/mo where cash flow turns negative within a 50-yr well life; P90/P10 from a hindcast-calibrated ensemble · k-means (k=2) on decline shape (rate kept after 1 and 3 producing years). Technical estimates, not SPE PRMS reserves.
